sloka: राज्ञः पादौ गृहीत्वा तु राज्ञा ते प्रतिपूजिताः ।पीठेष्वन्ये बृसीष्वन्ये भूमौ केचिदुपाविशन् ॥६-११-२४॥।।
transliteration: rājñaḥ pādau gṛhītvā tu rājñā te pratipūjitāḥ ।pīṭheṣvanye bṛsīṣvanye bhūmau kecidupāviśan ॥6-11-24॥।।

translations.english: They held the feet of the king and on offering salutations to the king took their seat. While some took golden seats, some sat on a kusa grass mat, and some took a se at on the floor.
